children: On August 31, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it failed to meet Listing Rule 5450(b)(1)(A) due to stockholders' equity of ($35.3M), below the $10M minimum. Trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market continues under QNCX; the company has until October 15, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, with a possible extension to February 27, 2027. It is evaluating options, including an application to list on the Nasdaq Capital Market and a potential name and ticker change to IRulya Therapeutics Inc. (IRLA) if approved.
